reviews.text: I am very happy with the services provided by the tub company. I have been using their services for over six years, and they have consistently delivered excellent results. From start to finish, their team is professional, punctual, and attentive to detail. The quality of their work truly stands out, and the entire process is always smooth and hassle-free. I appreciate their reliability and dedication, and I highly recommend their services to anyone looking for dependable, high-quality work.

Contacted the tub guys after reading the reviews and contacted them from their Facebook profile. Everything went through fb messenger. The price and appointment time was all transparent. Day of the appointment the tech Ivan arrived 20mins ahead which I thought was very professional. He was courteous and very respectful of my house and property. He cleaned up after himself very nicely after the work was done. The job was done to my satisfaction and I do recommend this company for your tub work and refinishing needs.
